nd-county-officials.summary: The County card names the county you picked, and not its commissioners or other elected officers. The card says so rather than leave the offices looking empty.
nd-county-officials.why: No statewide list of North Dakota's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
nd-county-officials.wanted: One statewide list of each county's commissioners and other elected officers, or a county's own published list of them.

nd-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City card names the city you picked, and not its mayor, commission or council.
nd-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of North Dakota's cities has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
nd-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each city's mayor, commission or council, or a city's own published list of them.

nd-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its school board.
nd-school-board-members.why: No list of the members of North Dakota's school boards has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
nd-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.
